verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports describe a built-in welcome/starter board that taught a new user everything in about 2 minutes (trello-comm-18), with another user asking that it also explain voting (trello-comm-13). This is a product-native onboarding aid, but these reports are old and informal, and no first-party documentation describes a guided first-time workspace setup flow. missing for 10: first-party docs of a guided workspace setup walkthrough, evidence it covers workspace (not just board) configuration, current/recent corroboration, engineer-specific onboarding path.
